# helper to fetch all pages from phone.search_contacts

def fetch_all_phone_contacts(relationship, page_limit=20):
    contacts = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship=relationship, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        # expect list
        if not page:
            break
        contacts.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return contacts
